source_members.aggregate_trace_and_disposition: Home validation binds settlement, population, canonical building seed, unique property identity and its exact building ID. It rejects zero capacity, nonfinite pose and nonpositive extents, reserves exactly the first home in each tier and excludes that reserve from resident capacity. Allocation revalidates, admits unique nonempty positive family counts, checks total before narrowing, consumes same home capacity and fills the remaining abstract population. Greedy first-fit may conservatively reject a whole-family layout despite enough aggregate capacity; no promise of optimal bin packing or ordinary false failure established. Parsing produces a mutable raw catalogue; validation returns unit rather than sealing it. Exact ROOT-PP-017 owns retained pose/identity migration, with fresh aggregate support here.
